title: Forward electronic reaction barriers from reactant and product geometries
domain: computational chemistry; reaction kinetics; machine learning

task_sources.name: Transition1x v4, published final-state geometries and energies

metric.description: Mean absolute error in eV over all 287 forward electronic barriers E_TS - E_R. Lower is better. Preserve negative values and all samples. Auxiliary RMSE, linearly interpolated P95 absolute error and fraction within 0.0433641 eV do not affect ranking. The result is a frozen DFT reference comparison, not an experimental rate or new-saddle validation.
